metric: Mean coding-category judge rating across both turns, 1-10

target.notes: Figure 9 chart reading, approximately 5.2/10, not a published numeric table entry.

method: Convert existing benchmarks with saved offsets; fit the Huber location of logit(existing score / 100) minus logit(rating / 10), delta 0.75. Existing benchmark offsets and runtime model scores stay fixed.
limits: Zyphra ratings are approximate chart readings to one decimal, with about 0.1 rating-point reading uncertainty.
Five references share a report; three are Llama models from related families. These are not six independent evaluation setups.
The ten coding questions are judged across two dependent turns. Ratings are not execution pass rates.
Validate on a held-out model, not on individual question ratings from a model included in the fit.
Calibration covers ratings 1.0-6.3; results above that range are extrapolations.
The Llama-3.2-1B plot label identifies the model; Table II's 1.2B label is inconsistent.
